articles.title: Grand Lisboa Palace Becomes Greater China’s First Sustained Carbon-Neutral Integrated MICE Venue
articles.summary: SJM announced that Grand Lisboa Palace has become Greater China’s first sustained carbon-neutral integrated MICE venue, achieved through high-quality carbon credits. The group also launched Macau’s first standardized zero-carbon MICE service after offsetting the venue’s 2025–2026 average emissions of about 5,827 tCO₂e.

articles.title: GEG Wins Four Accolades at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards; Including “Best Integrated Resort” for the Fourth Consecutive Year and “Best Individual CSR Initiative”
articles.summary: September 16, 2026 – Galaxy Entertainment Group (“GEG”) garnered four awards at the 2026 IAG Academy IR Awards in Manila, making it once again the most awarded integrated resort operator in Macau. Galaxy Macau was named “Best Integrated Resort” for the fourth consecutive year and “Best IR Gaming Floor,” Capella at Galaxy Macau was named “Best Hotel in an IR” for the second consecutive year, and the “GEG Sports for Good Community Program” received “Best Individual CSR Initiative.”

articles.title: The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary with Exclusive Moët & Chandon Dinners and Stunning Drone Shows
articles.rawDate: Sep.15 The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary with Exclusive Moët & Chandon Dinners and Stunning Drone Shows
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 15, 2026) – To mark a decade of French-inspired hospitality, The Parisian Macao hosted a three-night Moët & Chandon dinner event for government officials, VIPs and media. The soirées featured Executive Chef Jean-Michel Bardet’s five-course champagne-paired menus at Le Cristal Parisian, with views of the Eiffel Tower and 1,500-drone anniversary shows.

articles.title: 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival
articles.rawDate: Sep.13 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 13, 2026) – Sands China held the 2026 MSO Sands China Cup – Inclusive Community Basketball Carnival at the University of Saint Joseph, attracting over 250 residents from special education schools, community centres, care homes and secondary school teams. Co-organized with Macau Special Olympics and the University of Saint Joseph, the carnival promoted inclusion through basketball and built excitement for The NBA China Games 2026.

articles.title: The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary
articles.rawDate: Sep.10 The Parisian Macao Celebrates 10th Anniversary
articles.summary: (Macao, Sept. 10, 2026) – The Parisian Macao marked its 10th anniversary on Sept. 13. Since opening it has attracted more than 100 million visitors and become a Cotai Strip landmark, reflecting Sands China’s commitment to non-gaming development and Macao’s economic diversification.

articles.title: Four Wynn Restaurants Recognized in the Trip.Gourmet 2027 Global Fine Dining Awards
articles.summary: Macao, September 9, 2026 – Four of Wynn's signature restaurants have been honored at Trip.Gourmet's 10th Anniversary Edition: Global Restaurant Rankings and Fine Dining Awards Ceremony held in Singapore on September 8. Chef Tam's Seasons received the highest honor of "Black Diamond" award, while Mizumi, Wing Lei and Drunken Fish were each honored with the prestigious "Platinum" award.

articles.title: Five SJM Restaurants Are Honoured at Trip.Gourmet’s 10th Anniversary Awards
articles.summary: Five SJM restaurants were honoured at Trip.Gourmet’s 10th Anniversary Awards, presented at the global ceremony in Singapore on September 8, 2026.

articles.title: SJM Hosts Fortune Leaders Forums Macau Debut at GLP
articles.summary: SJM hosted the Macau debut of the Fortune Leaders Forum 2026 at Grand Lisboa Palace, gathering more than 250 senior executives, policymakers and investors. Managing Director Daisy Ho said the inaugural edition strengthens Macau’s role as an international centre for business dialogue.

articles.title: Three MGM Restaurants Recognized in Trip.Gourmet’s 2027 Global Fine Dining Selection
articles.summary: [September 8, 2026, Macau] Three of MGM’s signature dining restaurants have been listed on the Trip.Gourmet 2027 Global Fine Dining Selection. Aji makes its debut as a Platinum Restaurant, while returning honorees Five Foot Road and Imperial Court have been recognized as Diamond Restaurant and Platinum Restaurant, respectively.
